response.answer: Metadata, provenance, versioning, and access-control rules will be governed by blockchain and semantic web standards. Confidential BIM and permit data will be handled legally through strict data governance and compliance protocols. Legal technology will ensure ethical and lawful data sharing.

results.content: # Beyond BIM: A Guide to AI, Generative & Agentic Systems in Building & Construction. ## **Competing on Construction Intelligence —** *A Field Guide to Leveraging BIM‑Native AI, LLMs, and Agents for Durable Advantage.*. > Beyond BIM: A Guide to AI, Generative & Agentic Systems in Building & Construction” was developed in collaboration with **Mobeen Minai**, Operations Director for BIM at Mace (UK). A seasoned digital‐delivery leader, Mobeen steers Mace’s BIM strategy and standards, equips project teams with robust information workflows, and oversees quality control, data validation, and coordination on complex programs. With more than two decades in multidisciplinary practice, he has been a consistent champion of integrated, collaborative delivery and regularly trains project managers and design teams on best‑practice BIM. > **BIM** is the construction data spine for IM (Information Management). Dr. Adnan Masood is an Engineer, Thought Leader, Author, AI/ML PhD, Stanford Scholar, Harvard Alum, Microsoft Regional Director, and STEM Robotics Coach.
